H5P_FILE_ACCESS$set_cache()

This function implements the HDF5-API function H5Pset_cache. Please see the documentation at https://support.hdfgroup.org/documentation/hdf5/latest/group___h5_p.html for details.

Usage

H5P_FILE_ACCESS$set_cache(
  rdcc_nslots = 521,
  rdcc_nbytes = 2^20,
  rdcc_w0 = 0.75
)

Arguments

rdcc_nslots

The number of slots in the raw data chunk cache. Use -1 for the library default.

rdcc_nbytes

The size of the raw data chunk cache in bytes. Use -1 for the library default.

rdcc_w0

The chunk preemption policy, between 0 and 1. Use -1 for the library default.
